Escambia County Courthouse

Escambia County, located in the western panhandle of Florida, is a vibrant and growing community with a rich history and a bright future. The Escambia County Courthouse is a central part of that history and an important symbol of the county's progress and development. Escambia County was founded in 1821, and its first courthouse was established shortly thereafter. This early courthouse served as the center of government and justice for the growing county, and it was a hub of activity for many years. As the county continued to develop, so did the courthouse, and it became a symbol of the county's strength and stability.
